html:
On 7 August 1998, truck bombs exploded almost at the same time outside the United States embassies in Nairobi, Kenya, and Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, killing over 220 people, most of them Kenyans.

The attacks were carried out by al-Qaeda, the network of Osama bin Laden, who had lived in Sudan until 1996. Thousands were injured in Nairobi, where a nearby office building collapsed.

The United States struck back with cruise missiles on camps in Afghanistan and a factory in Khartoum. The bombings made bin Laden one of the most wanted men in the world, three years before the September 11 attacks. They were the first of several terror attacks in Kenya.
sum: On 7 August 1998, truck bombs exploded almost at the same time outside the United States embassies in Nairobi, Kenya, and Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, killing over 220 people, most of them Kenyans.
